'''Alexandre Rubén Martínez Gutiérrez''' (born 4 March 1987) is an Andorran former [[association football|footballer]] who played as a [[defender (association football)|defender]]. He earned seven caps for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]], having made his international debut in 2010.<ref name="nft">{{NFT player|38600|name=Alexandre Martínez}}</ref>
